entityTypes.name: cell
entityTypes.description: One whole-cell patched CA1 pyramidal neuron; one neuron per slice per day. The descriptor reports 7 cells from 2 mice on 2 days. Cells have no folder; identity is read from the recording file names.

entityTypes.name: recording
entityTypes.description: One ABF file: one repetition of the excitability protocol (0-450 pA, 50 pA steps, 500 ms) for a cell. Five repetitions (a-e) per cell.

cell_id.name: cell_id
cell_id.title: Cell ID
cell_id.description: Recording date (yyMMdd) and slice number on that day, e.g. 170518_1. One neuron was recorded per slice.

recording_date.name: recording_date
recording_date.title: Recording date
recording_date.description: Day of recording, from the yyMMdd prefix of the file name

slice_number.name: slice_number
slice_number.title: Slice number
slice_number.description: Number of the slice recorded on that day from the same animal (data descriptor naming convention)

protocol_repeat.name: protocol_repeat
protocol_repeat.title: Protocol repeat
protocol_repeat.description: Letter a-e: which of the five repetitions of the excitability protocol this file holds

dataLocations.displayName: Garad & Lessmann 2022, CA1 excitability ABF recordings
dataLocations.description: Flat folder of Axon Binary Format files named <yyMMdd>_<slice><repeat>.ABF, plus the EBRAINS data descriptor and licence PDFs. Category 'raw' per the descriptor (original Patchmaster recordings). Every entry in the folder was listed; nothing was sampled.
